## Available Vehicles / Fleet
1. Noah / Microbus (Main Service): Toyota Noah, Voxy (7-12 seats, fully air-conditioned, primary service for family tours, wedding events, corporate trips, and Rajshahi-Dhaka routes)
2. Sedan (Arranged on request): Toyota Premio, Allion, Axio, Corolla (Comfortable for 4 passengers, arranged on customer demand)
3. SUV (Arranged on request): Prado, Pajero (High clearance, luxury VIP travel arranged upon request)

## Pricing Policy
Car rental fares are flexible and determined based on trip location, distance, and direct discussion. For the best current rates, customers are encouraged to message directly on WhatsApp: +8801755964871.
